about: Openly licensed photos of the Ontario Line corridor that the media agent passes to the image model for a site's terrain, roads and existing buildings. Only CC0 and CC BY: never share-alike. Each is a Wikimedia Commons file at most 1280 px wide. Points are approximate: where the photo looks, not where it was taken. Subjects are the renders a photo can ground: one from the air grounds only a render seen from the air. Credits are in CREDITS.md.

photos.title: Don Valley bridge on August 20 2026
photos.shows: the wooded slopes of the Don Valley where the new bridge crosses the Don River and the Don Valley Parkway, with its first tall concrete piers and high-rise towers beyond
photos.author: Throwaway618420
photos.credit: Don Valley bridge on August 20 2026, by Throwaway618420, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons
